title: Door Lock Status — Halverson High School

lines.text: EOC, this is Facilities Lead 12 at Halverson High. The HUSD-VMS01 system is unresponsive — we lost control of the external doors. Door 1 (main entrance), Door 11, Door 14, and Door 16 are locked via the VMS, but they’re not sealing. Custodians are manually unlocking them to let students out. We have no way to confirm if they’re secured from the inside. We must use the 05:00 offline roster to verify who’s in the building.

Acknowledged. Confirm: all external doors are now under manual control. No networked lock status. Proceed with full headcount using the 05:00 offline roster. All staff report to main office. SRO, secure perimeter and confirm no unauthorized entries.

SRO to Facilities Lead 12: I’m on site. I’ve confirmed no one is entering or leaving via exterior doors. All entries are being logged manually at Door 1 and Door 14. We’re using the 05:00 roster to cross-check. No unauthorized access detected.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slightly out of breath

instructorNote: This inject confirms the loss of networked door control and forces the Site Incident Commander to activate manual accountability using the 05:00 offline roster. Watch for coordination between SRO, Facilities Lead, and Prin on headcount procedures.
